newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ZACCHERONI TO STAY AS UDINESE COACH NEXT YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZACCHERONI TO STAY AS UDINESE COACH NEXT YEAR.

text.p: Udinese coach Alberto Zaccheroni, whose players have beaten the top two teams in Italy in successive weeks, said on Monday he was staying at the northern club for another season.
"I haven't signed yet, but it's just a matter of days," Zaccheroni said. "We reached an agreement just before the away match against Parma."
The mid-table club had wanted to lock the coach into a three-year contract but Zaccheroni stuck out for a one-year deal.
Udinese, with German international striker Oliver Bierhoff back on form, beat second-placed Parma 2-0 on Sunday after beating leaders and European Cup holders Juventus 3-0 the previous weekend.
